title: The Impossible Brief
logline: Six minutes after MarkeVita closes, Vita and Leo receive a launch brief containing five impossible contradictions, solve it before morning, and discover that an unknown presence has entered their production system.

scenes.action: After-hours lobby. Vita stands alone in her canonical position, finishes a small welcoming gesture, notices that the room has gone quiet, and looks toward an off-screen alert.
scenes.camera_motion: locked frame with a very slow push-in
scenes.continuity_out: Vita turns her gaze toward the lobby entrance.

scenes.action: Leo enters quickly from the left carrying the matte-black coffee cup. Vita remains still and watches him approach.

dialogue.speaker: leo_mercer
dialogue.text: New client. Launch at nine. They sent no logo, no copy, no assets.

scenes.camera_motion: slow lateral track following Leo, settling into the two-shot
scenes.continuity_in: Vita is looking toward the entrance.
scenes.continuity_out: Leo stops one meter from Vita with coffee cup in right hand.

scenes.action: Vita gives Leo one measured look, then lets a minimal smile appear.

dialogue.speaker: vita
dialogue.text: So, a miracle with brand guidelines.

scenes.continuity_out: Her smile disappears as she waits for the actual brief.

scenes.action: First establishing view of the production room. Abstract light appears on the three displays as Vita and Leo take their fixed positions at the console.

dialogue.speaker: leo_mercer
dialogue.text: Can your system build a campaign from one sentence?

scenes.camera_motion: slow stabilized push toward the console
scenes.continuity_in: Leo still carries the coffee cup.
scenes.continuity_out: Vita stands left of console; Leo stands right.

scenes.action: Vita studies the abstract display without touching it, then shifts her eyes toward Leo.

dialogue.speaker: vita
dialogue.text: Yes. The dangerous part is which sentence.

scenes.continuity_in: Vita remains on the left side of the console.
scenes.continuity_out: A call indicator appears only as an abstract pulse, with no text.

scenes.action: Vita and Leo listen to the unseen client's recorded message. Neither speaks; their reactions remain restrained.

dialogue.speaker: client_voice
dialogue.text: Make us established, disruptive, timeless, young—and don't change anything.

scenes.continuity_in: Call pulse remains on the center display.
scenes.continuity_out: Leo slowly turns his head toward Vita.

scenes.action: Leo counts the contradictions silently on the fingers of his free left hand, then lowers it.
scenes.continuity_in: Coffee remains in Leo's right hand; watch remains on left wrist.
scenes.continuity_out: Leo looks from Vita to the displays.

scenes.action: Leo places the coffee cup on the front-right corner of the console. Vita raises one hand slightly and the displays reorganize into clean abstract compositions.

dialogue.speaker: vita
dialogue.text: Separate the intentions. Keep the trust. Remove the panic.

scenes.camera_motion: slow pan from the cup to Vita
scenes.continuity_in: Coffee cup begins in Leo's right hand.
scenes.continuity_out: Coffee cup is fixed on the console's front-right corner.

scenes.action: Several overly bright abstract campaign concepts flash across the displays. Vita makes one small dismissive gesture; the noisy concepts vanish and a restrained composition replaces them.
scenes.shot_type: over-shoulder medium shot from behind Vita, 50mm
scenes.camera_motion: slow controlled push toward the displays
scenes.continuity_in: Coffee cup remains visible on far right of console.
scenes.continuity_out: One clean ivory, gold, and charcoal concept remains.

scenes.action: Leo studies the restrained concept, then glances at Vita. Vita keeps her attention on the work.
scenes.camera_motion: locked camera; rack focus from Leo to Vita
scenes.continuity_in: Clean concept remains on displays; cup remains on console.
scenes.continuity_out: Leo accepts the logic with a small nod.

scenes.action: The final concept fills the center display as abstract shapes, with no readable text. Vita and Leo listen to the client's reply.
scenes.continuity_in: Final concept and coffee cup remain in place.

scenes.action: Leo leans lightly against his side of the console. Vita turns from the display toward him.

dialogue.speaker: vita
dialogue.text: Clients recognize decisions after they see them.

scenes.continuity_in: Coffee cup remains on front-right console corner.
scenes.continuity_out: Both briefly relax before the system changes.

scenes.action: The warm room lights flicker cool once. An unfamiliar dark geometric presence appears across the abstract displays. Vita becomes visibly concerned for the first time; Leo straightens.
scenes.continuity_in: Coffee cup remains on console; final concept is replaced by dark geometry.
scenes.continuity_out: Vita and Leo look toward the lobby.

scenes.action: Back in the lobby, the glass entrance locks with a quiet mechanical movement. Vita stands in foreground profile, then turns her eyes toward camera without smiling.
scenes.camera_motion: locked frame with a final minimal push-in
scenes.continuity_in: Vita has moved from the control room to the lobby; wardrobe remains unchanged.
scenes.continuity_out: Cut to black immediately after the line.
